Problem Statement:
Given a string 
text
 and a string 
pattern
, find all starting indices in 
text
 where 
pattern
 occurs as a substring. Use the Z Algorithm to efficiently find all occurrences. Return the list of starting indices (0-based). 
Input Description:
- The first line contains the string 
text
.
- The second line contains the string 
pattern
. 
Output Description:
- Print the starting indices (space-separated) of all occurrences of 
pattern
 in 
text
. If there are no occurrences, print an empty line. 
Sample Input:
ababcababcabc
abc 
Sample Output:
2 7 10 
Explanation:
The pattern "abc" occurs at indices 2, 7, and 10 in the text.
